truthful_boundary_clarification.proposal_claim_reviewed: K0 does NOT create real governed proposal artifacts through the authoritative proposal boundary (PatchGatingService, ProposalWorkflowStore, CouncilGate). ProposalResult records are in-memory refusal dispositions only.
truthful_boundary_clarification.why_not_real_proposals: The plan profile sets write_file/search_replace permission=never, which causes ToolRuntime to refuse mutation calls with REFUSED status. K0 records these refusals as ProposalResult with BLOCKED_BY_PERMISSION disposition. This is a refusal-disposition record, not a real governed proposal.
truthful_boundary_clarification.what_would_be_needed: Real governed proposal creation would require: setting patch_proposal_mode=True on the agent profile OR invoking the PatchGatingService directly, producing PatchProposal artifacts through ProposalWorkflowStore, and generating council-reviewed proposal receipts. All deferred to K/L integration pass.
